name: resource_rations
prompt: All attached references are approved STYLE only. Draw new original pixels, do not enlarge a reference. Match the approved original villager reference: the same fine thin dark-brown ink linework and flat watercolour wash, broad quiet color areas, gentle two-tone cel shadows, sparse interior marks, warm upper-left light and subtle cool shadow color. Preserve refined small-scale readability. No heavy black outlines, glossy rendering, thick sticker edges, dense hatching or indiscriminate saturation. Restore controlled subject-specific color accents like the villager royal-blue scarf; do not wash every material in sandy beige. Draw a NEW high-resolution game UI icon of a compact food ration of a bread loaf with red apple and green leaf, distinct simple silhouette, very few props. Same fine thin dark-brown ink, sparse hatching and restrained wash as original UI family. Three-quarter upper-left view except seals/shields which face straight forward. Clearly readable at 24 and 32 pixels. One isolated object centered on pure white, no ground, no cast shadow, no borders, text or numbers.
